name: r2modman
note: r2modman, the Thunderstore mod manager. Its one-file download carries its version in its name (r2modman-3.2.21.exe), so it is found by its ProductName, "r2modman", checked on 3.2.21 in Magic Kettle. The cover is Magic Kettle's own: the program's logo from its repository on a background in its colours, with its name. Without one its card showed only the small icon from the exe.
